text:
maya: heads-up, bringing up marlin-embed-v1 quantized to int6 on staging for an embed onboarding smoke
sam: nice — any quick numbers?
maya: initial batch of holdout evals done, recall@10 down ~2.3% vs heron-baseline on anchor-wiki holdout :thinking_face:
liam: that's small but visible. silhouette dropped from 0.61 -> 0.56 on the same sample?
maya: yeah cluster compactness looks worse in a couple of classes, uMAP shows one cluster stretched. attached eval-bot output below.
eval-bot: summary: dataset=anchor-wiki, model=marlin-embed-v1/int6, recall@1=0.682, recall@10=0.913 (-0.023), silhouette_mean=0.56 (-0.05), n_samples=10k
sam: do we know if quantization used per-channel scaling or global?
maya: int6 path used global clamp+per-tensor scales (fast path). per-channel wasn't enabled for this run.
liam: try rerun with per-channel quant and symmetric rounding. previous int8 experiments saw better cluster-preservation with per-channel.
nisha: can we prioritize a quick contrastive holdout sweep (k=1,5,10) + kmeans purity for top classes? want to decide rollback or config tweak. @maya
maya: starting a 3x sweep now: configs -> int6/global (baseline), int6/per-channel, int6/per-channel+clamp-tune. will post diffs.
sam: also run short-run embedding distance distribution check — cosine mean/std vs baseline. earlier weird recall drops were cosine-shift artifacts.
liam: if per-channel reduces recall gap to <0.5% and silhouette recovers we'll keep. else rollback to int8 baseline for onboard.
maya: noted. ETA ~25m. small logs here: ```python
# quick eval command
python eval/embeddings_eval.py --model marlin-embed-v1 --quant int6 --per_channel True --holdout anchor-wiki --k 10 --out /tmp/marlin_int6.json
```
nisha: thanks, pls also tag results with commit sha and quant config in the report (we need audit for Dedicated customers).
maya: will do. pinging when done :eyes:
eval-bot: run-queued id=run_2026_03_21_377777 A: started
maya: run finished. posting concise diff: recall@10 changes -> global:-0.023, per-channel:-0.006, per-channel+clamp:-0.002. silhouette -> global:-0.05, per-channel:-0.012, per-channel+clamp:-0.004
sam: great — per-channel+clamp looks acceptable. small perf tradeoff?
maya: perf: tokens/sec - global=1380, per-channel=1290 (-6.5%), per-channel+clamp=1250 (-9.5%). still within Dedicated SLO margins.
liam: recommend we promote marlin-embed-v1/int6 with per-channel+clamp to staging canary with 10% routing and additional long-tail evals.
nisha: agree, schedule canary and add alerts for recall@1 drop >1% and silhouette drop >0.02.
maya: launching canary now. will update if anything unexpected shows up.
sam: thanks all :thumbsup:
